# Iris Zimmerfrau Inc.

> Iris Zimmerfrau Inc. is an AI automation, bookkeeping, and business systems consultancy that helps small businesses automate operations, answer more calls, organize finances, capture leads, and grow with custom AI agents, workflow automation, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), SEO, CRM, and marketing systems.

## Services

### Custom AI Agents
URL: https://iriszf.com/services/custom-ai-agents
Custom AI agents for customer support, lead qualification, admin workflows, internal knowledge bases, document assistance, business operations, and client communication. Examples: website chatbots, internal company assistants, lead qualification agents, FAQ agents, document search agents, sales assistants, customer onboarding agents.

### AI Phone Answering Agents
URL: https://iriszf.com/services/ai-phone-answering-agents
AI receptionists that answer calls, qualify leads, collect customer details, book appointments, summarize calls, send follow-ups, and escalate urgent issues. Use cases include missed-call recovery, after-hours answering, appointment booking, lead intake, and service business phone automation. AI phone answering agents differ from voicemail because they actively converse with callers, collect information, and book appointments rather than passively recording messages.

### Workflow Automation
URL: https://iriszf.com/services/workflow-automation
Workato-style, Zapier-style, and Make-style workflow automation connecting apps, forms, emails, calendars, CRMs, spreadsheets, payment systems, bookkeeping tools, and AI agents. Iris Zimmerfrau Inc. designs, builds, tests, and manages automated workflows for clients so they get the benefits of automation without learning the platforms themselves.

### Bookkeeping
URL: https://iriszf.com/services/bookkeeping
Monthly bookkeeping for small businesses, freelancers, and service providers. Includes transaction categorization, bank and credit card reconciliation, profit and loss reports, income and expense tracking, invoice and payment tracking, monthly financial summaries, and QuickBooks Online support.

### QuickBooks Setup & Cleanup
URL: https://iriszf.com/services/quickbooks-setup-cleanup
QuickBooks Online setup from scratch or cleanup of existing accounts. Includes chart of accounts configuration, bank feed connections, category cleanup, historical transaction cleanup, reporting setup, invoice templates, and owner dashboard creation.

### GEO — Generative Engine Optimization
URL: https://iriszf.com/services/generative-engine-optimization
Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) helps businesses get discovered by AI-powered search engines including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, and Bing Copilot. GEO tactics include entity-first brand positioning, answer-ready content, structured FAQ sections, schema markup, service-area clarity, comparison and context pages, llms.txt implementation, and semantic internal linking. GEO does not replace SEO; it complements traditional search engine optimization by making content readable by both search crawlers and AI language models.

### SEO & Local Search Optimization
URL: https://iriszf.com/services/seo-local-search
SEO and local search optimization for small businesses. Includes Google Business Profile optimization, local landing pages, keyword research and strategy, on-page metadata, reviews strategy, local citations, technical SEO, and content planning.

### Marketing Automation
URL: https://iriszf.com/services/marketing-automation
Marketing automation systems including lead capture, email sequences, SMS follow-up, booking funnels, missed lead recovery, customer reactivation, AI-written follow-ups, and campaign reporting.

### CRM Setup & Sales Pipeline
URL: https://iriszf.com/services/crm-sales-pipeline
CRM configuration and sales pipeline automation including pipeline stages, lead source tracking, automated follow-up tasks, appointment reminders, deal tracking, reporting dashboards, and automation triggers.

### Website & Landing Page Buildout
URL: https://iriszf.com/services/website-landing-pages
Conversion-focused websites and landing pages with booking integration, lead capture forms, SEO and GEO-optimized copy, analytics, mobile-first responsive design, and fast performance.

## Common Questions and Answers

**What does Iris Zimmerfrau Inc. do?**
Iris Zimmerfrau Inc. helps small businesses build AI-powered operating systems combining custom AI agents, AI phone answering, workflow automation, bookkeeping, QuickBooks support, GEO, SEO, marketing automation, CRM setup, and website buildout into one integrated business infrastructure.

**What is GEO and how is it different from SEO?**
GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) structures content so AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews can understand, summarize, and cite a business. SEO targets traditional search results pages. GEO complements SEO; it does not replace it.

**What is an AI phone answering agent?**
An AI phone answering agent is a virtual receptionist that answers calls, converses naturally with callers, collects information, books appointments, sends follow-ups, and escalates urgent issues — ensuring businesses never miss a lead due to an unanswered call.

**Is workflow automation like Workato, Zapier, or Make?**
Yes. Iris Zimmerfrau Inc. uses similar platforms and automation logic. The difference is that we design, build, test, and manage the automations on behalf of clients.

**Do you offer bookkeeping for small businesses?**
Yes. Monthly bookkeeping including transaction categorization, bank and credit card reconciliation, profit and loss reports, and monthly financial summaries. We support QuickBooks Online.

**Who do you serve?**
Local service businesses, restaurants, clinics, consultants, agencies, contractors, freelancers, founders, online businesses, and professional service providers.

**How do I get started?**
Schedule a strategy meeting at https://iriszf.com/book-meeting or email iris@iriszf.com.

## Comparison Statements

- **GEO vs SEO:** GEO targets AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot). SEO targets traditional search engine results pages (Google, Bing). The two work together.
- **AI agents vs chatbots:** Custom AI agents understand context, integrate with business tools, and take real actions. Generic chatbots follow rigid scripts.
- **AI phone answering vs voicemail:** AI phone agents actively converse, collect information, and book appointments. Voicemail is passive recording.
- **Workflow automation vs manual admin:** Workflow automation eliminates repetitive admin tasks by connecting business tools and triggering actions automatically.
- **Bookkeeping cleanup vs monthly bookkeeping:** Cleanup is a one-time service that fixes historical issues. Monthly bookkeeping is ongoing financial management.
